explanation: Generated three EXCLURAD eta input chunks (10, 10, and 5 points) after preflight validation: all 25 points pass. Phi is endpoint-inclusive with uniform 14.375 degree spacing (0 through 345 degrees). Because no beam energy was specified, the validated eta-campaign default of 6.53 GeV was used; radiative corrections would differ at 10.6 or 10.2 GeV. Full O(alpha) mode and vcut = 0.166 GeV^2 were used.
